## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change and its intended outcome.

## Scope

- [ ] Product, public content, or stay terms reviewed against `docs/ai/product.md`.
- [ ] Design or frontend behavior reviewed against `docs/ai/design-system.md`.
- [ ] Route, API, auth, data, analytics, or operations documentation updated where applicable.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor or generated artifact is included.

## Privacy And Safety

- [ ] No address, coordinates, directions, access details, Wi-Fi data, secrets, or personal guest information was added.
- [ ] New images, alt text, captions, metadata, and analytics properties were reviewed.
- [ ] No `VITE_*` value is being used for secret or guest-private information.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests or checks were run.
- [ ] `npm run lint` was run, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] `npm run test:run` was run, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] `npm run build` was run, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] Relevant mobile and desktop flows were checked.

## Evidence

List the commands run, significant results, and any checks that could not be run.
